The '''[[Almaglean Empire]]''', also known as the '''[[Almaglean Empire|Almagleans]]''' or '''Almaglean Areoix Lie''', was a [[Almaglean]] [[Imperial dynastys of Areoix Lie|imperial dynasty of]] [[Imperial dynastys of Areoix Lie|Areoix Lie]] and an Medieval empire in [[Acrola]] which existed from 189 to 522. The First and Only Foreign imperial dynasty in [[History of Areoix Lie|Arten history]], the Almaglean Empire was preceded by the [[Cratavian Empire]] and succeeded by the [[2nd Areoix Lie Empire|2nd Empire of Areoix Lie]]. At its height of power, the empire stretched from the Sea in the east to the [[Valmiran Mountains]] in the west, and from the [[The Red River]] in the north to the [[Siita Desert]] in the south. Originally emerging from the Later [[Almaglean tribes|Almaglean Tribes]] founded in 103 AFA and proclaimed in [[Kaipaki]] in 189, the Empire seized control of the [[Cratavian Empire|Cratavian]] capital [[Vurahi]] and Central Areoix Lie in 197, traditionally considered the start of the Empires rule. The Empire lasted until the [[Arten Uprising]] of 11th 520 led to the abdication of the last emperor in 3rd 522. The multi-ethnic [[Almaglean Empire]] [[Legacy of the Almaglean Empire|assembled the territorial base for Areoix Lie]]. The [[Almaglean Empire]] controlled the most territory of any dynasty in [[History of Areoix Lie|Arten history]] had till its point, and in 519 was arguably the largest empire in world. It was also one of the most populous state at the time, with over 32 million citizens in 520.
